summary: Iter B Phase 1 (P0+P1) validation. Backend 37/37 passing (33 regression: Phase G iter155 12/12 + Phase E iter153E 9/9 + Phase F iter154 12/12 + 4 new iter_B tests covering PM scope on /api/search and lib.audit.append_audit smoke). Frontend: StatusBadge wired correctly on HrEmployees (243 lifecycle badges), DocumentExpirations (doc_exp), and PoRequests (29 po badges). GlobalSearch trigger + NotificationBell verified on all 5 target pages (Tasks, DocExp, PoRequests, HrEmployees, FieldLeadershipHub after MASCIGC password gate). EmptyState testIds present (po-empty hit on Closed tab). GlobalSearch overlay opens and returns results. TWO P1 BUGS FOUND below.

ui_bugs.component: Tasks.jsx — list rows (and drawer priority chip)
ui_bugs.issue: Tasks list rows STILL use the old inline STATUS_COLORS / PRIORITY_COLORS dicts (lines 210-215). Only the drawer status badge (line 309) was migrated to <StatusBadge>. Audit explicitly required: 'StatusBadge on Tasks page (task + priority domains): renders for both status and priority on every task row + drawer.' Result: 0 status-badge-task-* and 0 status-badge-priority-* testIds in DOM on /tasks. Also TaskDrawer priority chip (line 306) still uses PRIORITY_COLORS. Replace inline <span> with <StatusBadge kind="task" value={t.status} size="sm" /> and <StatusBadge kind="priority" value={t.priority} size="sm" />, then remove STATUS_COLORS/PRIORITY_COLORS constants from Tasks.jsx.

Page imports EmptyState but uses a hand-rolled inline <div data-testid='po-empty'> (lines 256-259) instead of <EmptyState testId='po-empty' />. The data-testid contract is satisfied, but the unification goal is not — the icon+title+hint structure differs from the shared component. Replace with <EmptyState icon={Receipt} title='No PO requests' hint='Nothing in this view yet.' testId='po-empty' />.

integration_issues.issue: document.scrollWidth=570, window.innerWidth=375 — page horizontally overflows by 195px. Offender is the filter row `<div class='flex items-center gap-2'>` inside the white filter bar (line 150 area of Tasks.jsx). That row contains a 200px-wide search input ('tasks-search-input') plus two Select triggers (140px + 180px) plus a Tabs control — total > 375 and does not wrap. Wrap the inner cluster with `flex-wrap` or stack the search input on its own row at <sm breakpoint. Other 3 standalone pages + leadership are clean (sw==iw==375).
